barRaise.topFinding: Apothecary is healthy in code and behind in shipping. Nine of the 23 open actions from 2026-09-09 closed on verified commits dated 2026-09-11, the queue says so, and every lens re-read the code to confirm it. Health moves from 79 to 80. The gap that matters now is the release: 16 commits sit above the v1.1.14 pill, so the live mirror still serves the pre-split editor and still prints drug-interaction caution text with no qualifier on the label, even though c4afa68 fixed that in source five days ago. That one release closes the top action, the canonical audit's eleven-day-old finding, and most of the compliance lens's drop from 55 to 42. The strategic question carried as a deferral for two runs is decided under D52: maintenance, not retirement, recorded in PROJECT_SPEC.md section 9 by 55a33ff.
